# ZeroTrace

> Defensive Cybersecurity, Digital Forensics & Media Sanitization Platform.

ZeroTrace provides military-grade data sanitization (NIST SP 800-88 Clear and Purge, DoD 5220.22-M) and advanced forensic file carving.

## Core Documentation

- [ZeroTrace Platform Home](https://zerotrace-gamma.vercel.app/): Main landing page with capabilities, architecture, and live audit telemetry.
- [About ZeroTrace](https://zerotrace-gamma.vercel.app/about): Company mission, cryptographic principles, and defense standards.
- [Secure Communications](https://zerotrace-gamma.vercel.app/contact): PGP-encrypted contact and security inquiries.
- [Terms of Service](https://zerotrace-gamma.vercel.app/terms): Platform license terms and compliance agreements.
- [Privacy Policy](https://zerotrace-gamma.vercel.app/privacy): Air-gapped privacy guarantees and zero-telemetry policy.
- [API Documentation](http://localhost:8000/docs): Interactive OpenAPI swagger specifications for backend daemon.

## Software Downloads

- [ZeroTrace Standalone Executable](https://zerotrace-gamma.vercel.app/ZeroTrace.exe): Portable Windows x64 binary for instant deployment.
- [ZeroTrace MSI Installer](https://zerotrace-gamma.vercel.app/ZeroTrace-Setup.msi): Windows x64 enterprise installer with desktop integration.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/MK-codes365/zerotrace): Open-source core engines, audit tools, and web interface.
